applicant.organisation: Statera Research Services GmbH (contract research organisation)

purpose: We run an epidemiological study commissioned by the Medical University of Vienna on regional variation in diabetes and need the aggregate counts.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
